title: New Custom Paintings - Crafting
description: A companion datapack, to New Custom Paintings that let's you craft the paintings added in the datapack
body:
> This pack is intended to be used with [New Custom Paintings - Datapack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/new-custom-paintings-datapack)

The `NewCustomPaintings-Crafting-Datapack` lets you craft the custom paintings added in a stonecutter. Again inspired by [Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/) Data Pack _Painting Picker_.
